intro.heading: The Same Five Problems Cost Builders Money on Every Project
intro.body: Budgets are prepared once and never updated. Subcontractors bill for more than they built. Clients call every day because they have no visibility. These are not isolated mistakes, they are what happens when a builder runs a multi-crore project on spreadsheets and WhatsApp.

personas.title: Budget Overruns Found After Handover
personas.body: Budgets are prepared once and never updated. By the time an overrun surfaces, the project is already done and there is nothing left to fix, only money already lost.

personas.title: Clients Calling for Updates Every Day
personas.body: Property buyers and investors have no visibility into what is happening on site. Every update requires a call, a photo search, and a manual summary, pulling the project manager away from actual work.

personas.title: Subcontractor Billing Exceeds Actual Work
personas.body: Subcontractors bill for more work than was executed. Without quantities linked to bills, overbilling passes undetected, and disputes happen only after the payment has already gone out.

personas.title: Labour Attendance Unverified Across Towers
personas.body: Supervisors mark registers by hand. Workers who were never on site still get counted, and payroll disputes follow every month, discovered only after wages are already paid.

personas.title: No Live Cost View Across Phases and Towers
personas.body: Project cost is visible only after every bill is in, usually after handover. An overrun that builds up over six months shows up as one number at the end, with no point where action was possible.

features.title: Deliver Projects On Time and Within Budget
features.body: Project scheduling, dependency tracking, and cost control give builders one live view of every tower. Set deadlines, monitor progress against plan, and catch budget overruns while there is still time to act.
bullets: Task allocation and dependency tracking across towers and phases
Delay alerts before they compound into missed handover dates

features.title: Give Clients Real Updates Without the Phone Calls
features.body: Property buyers and investors see milestone progress, geo-tagged photos, and handover timelines without calling the site office. Every update that goes out is logged, so nothing gets promised twice.
bullets: Milestone tracking visible to every authorized stakeholder
Progress photos shared automatically as work completes

features.title: Match Every Subcontractor Bill to Measured Work
features.body: Work orders carry quantities and rates. Bills are raised against completed and measured work only, so a subcontractor claiming more than was built gets caught before payment goes out, not after.
bullets: Multi-level approval before any bill is paid
Retention tracked automatically and released at milestones

features.title: Verify Labour Attendance Across Every Tower
features.body: GPS and face-verified check-ins replace manual registers, so wages are calculated from attendance that actually happened on site, not from what a supervisor wrote down at the end of the day.
bullets: Geo-tagged, face-verified check-ins on every site
Wages calculated automatically from verified attendance

items: GPS location captured at every check-in

faqs.q: How does SiteFlow prevent budget overruns from surfacing only at handover?
faqs.a: Budgets are built from the BOQ and mapped to cost categories. As procurement, site issues, and subcontractor bills are recorded, actuals post against the same lines automatically, so variance is visible by category throughout the project, not only at the end.

faqs.q: Can clients see project updates without calling the site team?
faqs.a: Yes. Milestone completion, geo-tagged progress photos, and timeline updates are shared automatically as they happen, so investors and buyers get real visibility without pulling a project manager away from site work.

faqs.q: How does SiteFlow stop subcontractor overbilling?
faqs.a: Every work order carries agreed quantities and rates. Bills are checked against measured, completed work before approval, and multi-level sign-off ensures no payment goes out without the right verification.

faqs.q: Does this work across multiple towers and phases at once?
faqs.a: Yes. SiteFlow is built for multi-tower, multi-phase projects, with a consolidated view of budget, progress, attendance, and billing across every tower from one dashboard.
